assertions.title: loom serve /api/health responds within 5s of launch
assertions.notes: internal/cli/serve_e2e_test.go spawns a real `loom serve` subprocess and polls GET /health via the waitForServeReady helper to confirm the server becomes ready. However, the helper uses a 10s timeout and asserts only that the server eventually returns status=ok; it does not measure or assert elapsed time from process start to first successful /health response, nor does it fail if startup exceeds the 5s SLO. Partial: correctness of startup is covered, but the <5s latency budget is not enforced.

assertions.title: 100 concurrent issue-create requests succeed
test_names: concurrent creates all succeed and return distinct IDs
concurrent creates all delivered via SSE to browser
assertions.notes: concurrent-ops.integration.spec.ts issues 5 concurrent POST /api/workspaces/{id}/issues requests via Promise.all and verifies all succeed with distinct IDs — this is behaviorally the same path as the assertion but at 1/20th the scale and without asserting the response-status invariant (2xx or 429 only; no 5xx). TestHandleCreateIssue_Success / TestHandleCreateIssueW_* exercise the HTTP create handler with httptest.NewRecorder at single-request scale. TestHandleClientErrors_RateLimit and TestHandleCSPReport_RateLimit verify 429 responses under burst, but on /api/client-errors and /api/csp-report respectively — not the /issues endpoint. BenchmarkConcurrentAgents drives 4 concurrent RPC creators through the daemon (not HTTP). TestClaimMetrics_ConcurrentAccess uses 100 goroutines but against the fleet claim-metrics counter, not the issue-create HTTP path. Partial: concurrent create behavior is covered at small scale, but no test drives 100 concurrent POST /issues and asserts only {2xx, 429}, no 5xx.

assertions.title: Issue-update burst 1000/min sustainable
test_names: concurrent PATCH of different fields preserves all changes
concurrent PATCH of same field resolves without corruption
assertions.notes: Individual PATCH-to-SSE propagation is well covered: TestSSE_MutationDelivery_Update and TestSSELive_MutationDelivery assert that an update mutation results in an SSE payload reaching registered clients. concurrent-ops.integration.spec.ts runs 4–5 concurrent PATCHes via Promise.all and checks data integrity. TestHandlePatchIssueW_* cover single PATCHes at the handler layer. BenchmarkDaemonUpdate and BenchmarkUpdateIssue_Large provide throughput figures at the RPC/storage layers but contain no SSE assertions and no sustained-rate check. Partial: single and small-batch PATCH-with-SSE are covered, but no test drives a sustained 1000/min PATCH burst through the HTTP layer and asserts both (a) sustained success and (b) every mutation reaches SSE subscribers.

assertions.title: Daemon pool scales beyond default on contention
assertions.notes: internal/webui/daemon/pool_test.go covers pool mechanics — TestConnectionPool_ConcurrentGetPut spins 5 goroutines that Get/Put against a mock daemon, and TestConnectionPool_ConcurrentStats uses 10 concurrent stats readers. TestConnectionPool_Get_PoolExhausted verifies pool-timeout behavior. TestMultiPool_ConcurrentAccess exercises multi-workspace dispatch under concurrency. BenchmarkDaemonLatency in third_party/beads/internal/rpc/bench_test.go measures single-call latency. None of these drive 50 concurrent HTTP-layer callers against an issues list endpoint or assert a p95 checkout <2s SLO under contention. Partial: pool contention correctness is tested at 5–10 goroutines but the 50-caller-with-p95-latency scenario behind the validation pass is not enforced.

assertions.title: loom init on empty dir <5s
assertions.notes: internal/cli/init_e2e_test.go runs the real `loom init` subprocess across nine scenarios (legacy flag, worktree creation, custom names, idempotency, missing git, custom worktrees dir, pre-initialized beads, hooks installation, prereq exit code) and asserts correctness of stdout/filesystem side effects. None of these tests measure or assert elapsed time — no call to time.Since, no deadline check against 5s. Partial: init correctness is extensively covered but the <5s latency SLO is not enforced.
